setup: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const src=path.join(process.env.CHISACODE_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH||'','packages/server/.env'); const dst=path.join(process.env.CHISACODE_WORKTREE_PATH||'','packages/server/.env'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.copyFileSync(src, dst)"

app.command: cd packages/app && BROWSER=none EXPO_PUBLIC_LOCAL_DAEMON="localhost:${CHISACODE_SERVICE_DAEMON_PORT}" npx expo start --port $CHISACODE_PORT
